headline: Goal: ScoreBox app network discipline + odds refresh control + Moves tab, shipped as v3.0.42. Core Intent: save API quot
summary: ScoreBox Android single-WebView sports score app (user tjshea90). UI+logic: app/src/main/assets/index.html (vanilla, no build). MainActivity.java thin shell: serves assets, relays ESPN/odds GETs past CORS. Repo github.com/tjshea90/scorebox, branch ccr-bfc07519-v7jydl mirrored to main. Earlier turn: no internet on open; network only on pull-down/Sync or live features; odds APIs only when Odds on (shipped v3.0.39). This turn shipped v3.0.42 (main f45e56e, build run 42 success, APK https://github.com/tjshea90/scorebox/releases/download/v3.0.42/ScoreBox-v3.0.42.apk). Five requests: (a) bigger settings gear; (b) Odds refresh toggle: on = odds refresh only on pull-down/Sync; off = cached odds visible, zero odds API calls; (c) schedules+scores refresh every Sync/pull as before (yesterday, today, +1, +2, viewed day, NFL/CFB Thu-Mon week), time changes/postponements picked up; (d) odds for non-today day only when selected + Odds on + pull/Sync; (e) Moves tab: compare saved odds last sync vs latest refresh, biggest move first (spread -5 to -9 = 4 pts; total 154 to 165 = 11 pts). Intent: save user data/API quota, predictable network use, bettor-style line-movement view that stays out of the way.
taskDescription: Goal: ScoreBox app network discipline + odds refresh control + Moves tab, shipped as v3.0.42. Core Intent: save API quota/data, predictable network use (only pull-down/Sync or live features), line-movement view that stays out of the way.

keyDecisions: Decision: state.oRef (pref key orf, default on) separate from state.odds — Reason: hide odds vs stop refreshing independently.
Decision: oddsSync() returns early unless both on — Reason: single choke point for all odds API calls.

Decision: odds download only via runSync(pairs, silent, withOdds=true), passed only by syncAll() (Sync button + pull-to-refresh) — Reason: launch, day nav, toggles, source switches, key saves, timers, visibilitychange, online, Live sync, Track live never call odds APIs. Consequence: Live sync no longer refreshes odds (user informed). Turning Odds on does not fetch by itself.

Decision: odds refresh off keeps saved odds on screen, odds cache untouched (incl. ESPN-embedded line folding), stale label suppressed; Moves tab still reads saved data — Reason: user wants zero odds calls with cached data still usable.
Decision: odds days = today + viewed day only (oddsDays) — Reason: other days download only when selected.
Decision: Moves tab = last tab in league strip, shown only with Odds on, reads cache only (no network), shows viewed day — Reason: no network from a view tab.

Decision: round-based comparison: oddsSync snapshots saved odds for [today, viewed day] before a round, markMoves() diffs after; changed part keeps previous version as book.pv[part] = previous line + timestamp; unchanged later round leaves it so move stays listed (with age) until line moves again — Reason: repeated no-change syncs must not wipe a move the user wants to see.

Decision: ranking: spread/total points as-is; money line 10 cents = 1 point; price-only change (line unchanged) 20 cents = 1 point; games sorted by biggest move; rows sorted inside card; shown book follows Books picker else Pinnacle-first default — Reason: same book the cards show.
Decision: gear = 48x44 touch target, 28px glyph; media queries <=400px and <=340px tighten header — Reason: fit 360/320px phones.

Decision: added tools/e2e (Chromium + mocked services, run: bash tools/e2e/run.sh) and tools/test_syntax.sh (tools/ckpt.sh runs every tools/test_*.sh per checkpoint, must stay fast) — Reason: regression guards for network rules and blank-app syntax errors.
Decision: README + in-app footer rewritten for new network rules and Moves tab.

userDecisions.decision: No automatic internet use on app open; refresh only on pull-down/Sync or live features; odds APIs only when odds on.
Odds refresh toggle: on = odds refresh with schedules/scores only on pull-down/Sync; off = cached odds stay available, no odds API calls at all.
Schedules/scores must keep refreshing on every pull/Sync, including two days ahead.
Odds for a non-current day only if that day selected, odds toggle on, and pull/Sync.
Odds movement lives in a separate tab, compares last sync vs latest refresh, biggest movement first.

failedApproaches: Approach: Recorded previous line on every write inside applyBooks (putPart) → Result: false moves when two sources write same book (ESPN-embedded DraftKings then PropLine DraftKings in one sync) → Lesson: compare whole refresh rounds, not individual writes; replaced by per-round snapshot/diff, covered by tools/e2e/moves-sources.js.
Approach: First gear enlargement (48px) → Result: header overflowed at 360px and 320px → Lesson: fixed with media queries; test header at 320/360/411px.
Approach: Foreground 'sleep N' in Bash → Result: blocked by harness → Lesson: use run_in_background for waits.

Approach: tools/ckpt.sh + tools/push.sh push every checkpoint to main → Result: each checkpoint triggers release build (v3.0.40, v3.0.41 partial; v3.0.42 final) → Lesson: expect one release per checkpoint; point user at newest only.
Approach: \uXXXX escapes via edit tool → Result: became literal UTF-8 characters → Lesson: harmless (page is UTF-8) but greps for \u sequences may miss them.
modifiedFiles: app/src/main/assets/index.html: gear CSS + narrow-phone media queries; Odds refresh state/pref/#orfRow/#orfBtn/hint; oddsSync guard + snapshot/markMoves; runSync withOdds param; removed odds calls from timers/visibility/online/goDay/setOdds/source toggles/key save/sheet close; boot sync removed; Moves module (partMoves, movesForDay, renderMoves etc.) + Moves tab in renderTabs/render/updateMeta/refreshAges + .mv* CSS; stale label suppressed when refresh off; footer + empty-day hint text.
README.md: new 'When the app uses the internet' and 'Moves tab' sections; Fresh bullet rewritten; Live sync note.
tools/e2e/network-rules.js, moves-variants.js, moves-sources.js, run.sh: new Chromium suite.
implicitRules: Stack: vanilla JS single-file app in Android WebView; data from ESPN scoreboard + Pinnacle site API (free), PropLine / The Odds API (user keys), all relayed by MainActivity.
localStorage prefix sbx2:; schedules sbx2:<league>:<yyyymmdd>; odds sbx2:o-<league>:<yyyymmdd>; API keys sbx2:okeys; prefs sbx2:prefs.

Repo rules (CLAUDE.md): main = single source of truth; before work git fetch origin main and HEAD..origin/main must be empty; push HEAD:main triggers 'Build and release APK'; tag v<versionName>.<run_number>; after EVERY app change wait for run to complete and give user direct APK link, unprompted.
tools/ckpt.sh: run after each meaningful edit; commits+pushes, updates CHECKPOINT.md (resume file). Chromium e2e: Playwright preinstalled; bash tools/e2e/run.sh serves assets on port 8765.
Old-WebView .nogap CSS fallback needs explicit margins for any new flex-gap row.
User prefs: Android 16 target; frequent GitHub checkpoints + handoff protocol; longer sessions ok if product better.
nextSteps: User tries v3.0.42 on phone; report gear size, header fit, Odds refresh toggle, Moves layout issues (no real-device test done yet).
